notes: Shared-hosting updater now verifies and applies large packages through resumable browser-safe steps.
Update progress pages continue automatically while keeping the manual continue button as a fallback.
Admin-managed logos, favicon, user image, bot image folders, and upload folders are preserved during upgrades.
Verification progress can recover if shared hosting loses the temporary job file while package metadata still exists.
Update Center diagnostics and package checks are improved for common cPanel, Plesk, and DirectAdmin environments.
operator_notes: Upload install ZIP contents for new installations.
Use the upgrade ZIP through Admin Settings > Update Center for existing installations.
Never overwrite .env, storage, public/storage, or uploaded user files manually.
Configure real wallet addresses, SMTP, support details, and live chat after install.
